p:name.p:item: CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication setting

p:comment.p:item: Set the operation mode of the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication function.
The module hardware error occurred.
Power off and on the module power supply. If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Synchronous communication with the master station an error was detected.

Take any of the following actions, and then turn off and on the power supply of the I/O module or perform remote reset. - Check that the system configuration meets the specifications by referring to the master station manual. - Check that there is no communication error at the another station. - Check if another station has been remote reset. - Take measures against noise on the transmission path.
If the error recurs after performing these steps, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Synchronous communication with the master station an error was detected.

Take any of the following actions, and then turn off and on the power supply of the I/O module or perform remote reset. - For the synchronization cycle setting for the master station, set a long cycle. - Reduce the number of device stations operating with the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication function. - Take measures against noise on the transmission path.
The external power supply voltage turns off.

- Check the state of the external power supply. - Check if the power supply voltage satisfies the specifications for the I/O module. - Correct the timing of turning on or off External power supply monitor request (RWw2.b9) if an error occurs when starting or stopping the system.
The IP address and subnet mask stored in the non-volatile memory are abnormal.

- The module will be automatically recovered immediately after the error occurs. However, the stored IP address and subnet mask are lost, and operation is performed assuming that the following are stored. IP address: 192.168.3.250 Subnet mask: 255.255.255.0 - Take measures against noise with a shielded cable for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

p:name.p:item: IP address/station number setting switch out of range error

p:comment.p:item: The IP address/station number setting switches are set to 255.
Turn on the power supply with the IP address/station number setting switches set to a value in the range 0 to 254.
The MODE switch is set to an incorrect state.
- Set the MODE switch correctly. - When using the CC-Link IE TSN Class setting function, perform a firmware update so that the firmware of the I/O module becomes the latest.
The parameter data stored in the non-volatile memory are faulty.

- Correct the parameters. The I/O module operates with the parameters set by the function setting switch. - If the parameter is set by the function setting switch, clear the parameter. - Take measures against noise with a shielded cable for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Deleted the parameter stored in non-volatile memory.
Turn off and on the power supply of the I/O module or perform remote reset. The I/O module operates with the parameters set by the function setting switch after the reset.
The module parameter cannot be saved because an error in access to the non-volatile memory was detected.

- Module parameter is not saved in the non-volatile memory. - Take measures against noise with a shielded cable for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

In the I/O module for which the operation mode of the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication setting is set to the synchronous timing control mode or the time synchronous control mode, the network synchronization communication setting of the network configuration setting is set to "Asynchronous".

Take any of the following actions, and then turn off and on the power supply of the I/O module or perform remote reset. - When setting the operation mode of CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication setting to synchronous timing control mode or time synchronous control mode, set the network synchronous communication setting of the network configuration setting to "Synchronous". - When setting the network synchronous communication setting of the network configuration setting to "Asynchronous", set the operation mode of the CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication setting to the synchronous X/Y control mode.

The I/O module stored set IP address in non-volatile memory, but change of IP address is not reflected in module operation, and work in IP address before change. Please carry out power off and on the module or remote reset. In this way, change of IP address is reflected by module operation.

p:name.p:item: Module power supply voltage drop error

p:comment.p:item: The module power supply voltage is dropped.
- Check the state of the module power supply. - Check if the power supply voltage satisfies the specifications for the I/O module.
The IP address cannot be saved because an error in access to the non-volatile memory was detected.

- The IP address is not saved into the non-volatile memory. - Take measures against noise with a shielded cable for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
The error cannot be saved because an error in access to the non-volatile memory was detected.

- An error that occurred at the time of or before this error may not be saved into the non-volatile memory. - Take measures against noise with a shielded cable for connection. - If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.

p:name.p:item: CC-Link IE TSN Network synchronous communication setting change

p:comment.p:item: The contents of the CC-Link IE TSN network synchronous communication settings were changed after the I/O module were datalinked once.
Power off and on or remote reset the I/O module. It operates with the changed settings.
Remote reset could not be performed because the setting of the NETWORK switch or the LINK SPEED switch is different from the setting it had when the module was powered on.
Return the NETWORK switch and LINK SPEED switch to the settings they had when the module was powered on, and then perform remote reset again.
For the I/O module which started firmware update, indicator display (start or stop) was carried out.
After having carried out power off and on the module, please carry out indicator display again.

p:name.p:item: Synchronous communication error (time synchronization accuracy error)

p:comment.p:item: During synchronous communication with the master station, the difference between the master station's time and its own time exceeded 1us.

- Connect the same number of device stations to each port of the master station. - Reconnect device stations after the I/O module to a different port on the master station. - Check that there is no communication error at the another station. - Check if another station has been remote reset. - Take measures against noise on the transmission path.
If the error recurs after performing these steps, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Invalid network settings were received.
Power off and on the module power supply. If this error persists, the module may be in failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
Network settings that cannot be handled by the I/O module were received.

Check that the model name of the device station set in the network configuration settings matches the model name of the actual device. If this error occurs even when the model names match, perform a firmware update so that the firmware of the I/O module becomes the latest. If this error occurs even with the latest firmware, the possible cause is a module failure. Please consult your local Mitsubishi representative.
An IP address duplication is detected.
Change the IP address so that no IP address duplication occurs in the access range of CC-Link IE TSN. After change, power off and on the module power supply.
Values the I/O module cannot use were set for the IP address and subnet mask settings.

- Without using the set IP address and subnet mask, the module is operated based on the previous IP address and subnet mask. - The set IP address and subnet mask will not be saved in non-volatile memory. - Check the IP address and subnet mask again, and change the settings to values the I/O module can use. After change, power off and on the module power supply.
The network synchronous communication setting of the I/O module was set to "Synchronous".
Set the network synchronous communication setting of the I/O module to "Asynchronous". Or, perform a firmware update so that the firmware of the I/O module becomes the latest.
RX/RY with a number of points that cannot be handled by the I/O module were set.
Set 32 or less for the number of points for RX and RY in the network configuration setting.
RWr/RWw with a number of points that cannot be handled by the I/O module were set.
Set 144 or less for the number of points for RWr and RWw in the network configuration setting.

p:name.p:item: Communication cycle setting error (CC-Link IE TSN Class B/1Gbps)

p:comment.p:item: When the I/O module was operating at CC-Link IE TSN Class B and communication speed of 1Gbps, a communication cycle the I/O module could not support was set.
For the communication cycle setting, set a value supported by the I/O module.

p:name.p:item: Communication cycle setting error (CC-Link IE TSN Class B/100Mbps)

p:comment.p:item: When the I/O module was operating at CC-Link IE TSN Class B and communication speed of 100Mbps, a communication cycle the I/O module could not support was set.
For the communication cycle setting, set a value supported by the I/O module.
The system area (RWr3/RWw3) is not set in the RWr setting and RWw setting.
Set the RWr setting and RWw setting in the network configuration settings to allocate the system area (RWr3/RWw3).
The synchronization cycle set in the master station is not supported by the I/O module.
Check the synchronization cycle of the master station, and then turn off and on the power supply of the I/O module or perform remote reset.

p:name.p:item: Communication cycle setting error (CC-Link IE TSN Class A)

p:comment.p:item: When the I/O module was operating at CC-Link IE TSN Class A, a communication cycle the I/O module could not support was set.
For the communication cycle setting, set a value supported by the I/O module.
